items.text: The chase camera no longer goes inside the ground or walls
Map: SET WAYPOINT and GO buttons beside the current mission
Mission board: tap a job to hear it read aloud, then ACCEPT or DECLINE; drop a job any time with DISENGAGE
Taking a prisoner to their own faction frees them, turns that faction hostile and locks its mission board
SILVER fleet invasion missions: battleships, warships and a command station, with allied fighters on your side
New mission pictures, framed in difficulty colours from blue to gold
SPECIAL before it charges = EVADE: climb, dive, burst and barrel rolls by stick direction; tap again while climbing or diving for a U-turn
Far planets no longer flicker on and off
Tap the mission line at the top to set a waypoint; GO TO flies the whole job, through jump gates and in to dock
Handing in a captured bounty: the giver thanks you, pays and opens the bounty board
Bigger mission board text; every job has a picture
Music changes by star system; big fights get epic music
Bottom-left flight buttons in order: engine kill, stop, thrust, warp
